name: Bachelor of Innovation with Honours Scholarship (SCU)
summary: $5,000 for graduates with a GPA of 5 or more enrolled in SCU's Bachelor of Innovation with Honours.
who: Enrolled full-time or part-time in the Bachelor of Innovation with Honours.
Hold an Australian bachelor degree with a GPA of at least 5.00.
how: Apply using the Apply now link on the scholarship page, with a personal statement and a 300-word research statement.
catches: Four scholarships, and the panel may offer fewer.
